# Act V: Gaps vs Burden

*The map's whole point.*  Variables: study counts × GBD DALYs (country total + 22 Level-2 causes) × income, via `crosswalk_mesh_gbd.csv`.

| Figure | Status | Strength | Key Message |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| **C21** | ✅ Built | ★★★ Hero | **18× gap** evidence/DALY (HIC vs LIC median) |
| **C22** | ✅ Built | ★★★ Hero | Maternal-neonatal 3.6× (HIC) vs 0.37× (LMIC); injuries 0.21× |
| **C23** | ✅ Built | ★★★ Hero | India +4,847 short; Nigeria +1,205; absolute deficits in populous LMICs |
| **C24** | ✅ Built | ★★★ Hero | Injustice quadrant: Nigeria, DRC, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Uganda |
| **C30** | ✅ Built | ★★★ Hero | **Within-LMIC Gini 0.50**; bottom 50% burden = 16% evidence |
| **C29** | ✅ Built | ★★★ Hero | Injuries stuck at 1% research vs 11% burden |
| **T4** | ✅ Built | Timeline | CUA 45%→54%, CEA 34%→25% (method shift) |
